# Copied dependencies

These files are copied without modification from the existing Möbius project:

- `three.module.js`: Three.js r136, MIT license. Original copyright and SPDX header retained.
- `OrbitControls.js` and `TransformControls.js`: the controls bundled with that Three.js copy. `TransformControls.js` includes the original project's custom event payload.
- `catart.wasm.js`: the original CatArt Emscripten runtime, compiled DSP, and embedded decoder/distance assets. Existing headers and embedded data retained.

No original project file is modified by this extraction. The new widget adapters live one directory above this folder.
